diagnosis: Customer on the startup plan with basic support tier is asking about enabling SSO. Their current entitlements include only data_export, and per kb-0010 SSO is included on standard and premium support tiers, so this requires a plan change rather than a configuration action.
reply: Thanks for reaching out about SSO. On your current plan, SSO is not included — it is available on our standard and premium support tiers, so enabling it would require a plan change on your side. You can review plan options and upgrade from your account settings, and our article 'Feature availability by plan tier' (kb-0010) outlines which features come with each tier. If you'd like help comparing plans before making a decision, let us know and we'll be glad to assist.
